name: Ufm01 → Clear Accumulated Flow
description: Clears the accumulated flow stored on the UFM-01. The command is sent once the UART is idle and the automation continues right away; the meter's acknowledgement, or a timeout, is logged. A request made while one is still pending joins it instead of sending a second command.
